cases.title: Tamponade - TEE Requested After Suboptimal TTE
cases.vignette: 64-year-old female admitted to ICU with severe cellulitis, develops progressive hypotension refractory to vasopressors. Suboptimal transthoracic imaging by ICU team suggests possible pericardial effusion. TEE requested. See clips below.
cases.quiz: You see the vignette + clips above. What is the key diagnosis and what two echo signs support tamponade physiology?
cases.findings:
1. Large circumferential pericardial effusion
2. Right atrial systolic collapse
3. Right ventricular diastolic collapse

cases.title: Transthoracic Infective Endocarditis - Test Case

cases.quiz: What vegetations or valve lesions do you see? Which valve is involved?
cases.findings:
Placeholder discussion:
1. Mobile echodensity on valve leaflet suggestive of vegetation
2. Assess valve regurgitation severity
3. Look for abscess, perforation, dehiscence

cases.title: Transesophageal Infective Endocarditis - Test Case
cases.vignette: 62-year-old female with prosthetic valve and persistent bacteremia. Suboptimal TTE. TEE requested. Placeholder vignette for testing.
cases.quiz: What does TEE add over TTE here? Describe vegetation size, location and complications.
cases.findings:
Placeholder discussion:
1. TEE better for prosthetic valve and anterior structures
2. Measure vegetation size and mobility
3. Evaluate for paravalvular abscess or leaflet perforation

findingsItems.text: TEE better for prosthetic valve evaluation
Evaluate for paravalvular abscess or perforation

cases.title: Pericardiocentesis - Ultrasound-Guided - Test Case

cases.quiz: What is the safe window? Describe needle trajectory and monitoring during drainage.
